Fetch today's Toutiao trending news with titles, hotness scores, links, covers, labels, and category tags across multiple topics in Chinese.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: fetches trending news from 今日头条 (toutiao.com) across multiple categories including politics, finance, society, international, technology, and entertainment.
- Outputs news item title, popularity value, cleaned detail link, cover image (if available), label, aggregation ID, and category tags.
- Includes command-line interface for retrieving full or partial trending lists.
- Handles missing fields and features basic anti-scraping measures (random User-Agent, timeout control).
